title: Nexus Protocol Token DAO - Governance Metrics Schema
description: Scoring and health metrics for DAO governance: proposals, execution, participation, and policy compliance.

snapshot_id.description: Unique identifier for this governance metrics snapshot.

timestamp.description: Time at which this governance snapshot was taken.

proposal_quality.description: Average quality score of proposals in the window.

execution_reliability.description: Success rate of proposal execution (on-chain + off-chain).

participation_health.description: Voter turnout, delegation activity, and proposal throughput combined.

policy_compliance.description: Degree to which governance actions adhere to DAO policies.

proposal_count.description: Number of proposals in the measurement window.

failed_executions.description: Number of proposals that failed during execution.
